brief: One consistent CouncilKit high-fidelity design suite; design only, no application implementation.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality high-fidelity UI for CouncilKit, a local-first multi-agent PR review desktop web application. This is one coherent design suite for frontend implementation, not alternative directions. App UI only, no Chrome browser UI, no external vertical tabs, no device bezel, no poster heading outside the app. Attachments are real product references; preserve its restrained dark professional language while greatly improving hierarchy, readable typography, and information structure. Current date anchor: 2026-09-20. All visible sample content is DEMO review data, not factual claims about a real PR.
TARGET: desktop app screenshot 1440 x 1024. Sharp pixel-perfect flat product UI, readable Simplified Chinese. No illustration, no gradients, no giant decorative hero, no noisy shadows. Enough whitespace, purposeful alignment, simple dividers, no cards nested in cards. Use icons as small conventional thin line icons.
DESIGN SYSTEM: background #0b0d10, sidebar/surface #15181d, raised/hover #1e2128, divider #232830, primary text #e6e8ec, muted #a0a6b0 (brighter than reference for readability), warm headings #efe4cf, brass #c4a574 for selected navigation and primary action, red #f85149 for requires changes, green #22c55e ONLY for execution success/no issues, blue #58a6ff for running, amber #d29922 for caution. Primary button brass fill with dark text. 6px radii, 1px subtle borders only when needed. Body Chinese system sans 15-16px, secondary 13px, headings 24-28px, section headings 18px; monospace only for SHA/time/path/code at 12-13px. At most system sans + monospace (CouncilKit wordmark may retain source styling).
GLOBAL SHELL invariant: 208px left sidebar full height, logo CouncilKit at x24,y34; nav entries 首页, 新建讨论, 产品创意, 报告 (selected in warm muted brass tint); bottom 设置 and green dot Host 在线. Main starts x208 with 40px side padding. Page header breadcrumb 报告 / PR 审查, title "piston #413", small metadata "演示数据 · 2026/09/20 · SHA 6424bc1". Always keep current Run execution status separate from review verdict. No fabricated percent progress or ETA. Role labels use 安全审查、正确性审查、可维护性审查、对抗审查、兼容性审查, not model names as primary labels. Example models are metadata, not primary UI.
Demo final review totals invariant across completed screens: 5/5 seats executed successfully, Aggregator completed, 7 deduplicated findings: 1 致命, 2 重大, 3 次要, 1 建议; total verdict 需要修改. Seat independent finding counts: 安全审查 2, 正确性审查 1, 可维护性审查 3, 对抗审查 3, 兼容性审查 2 (overlap so don't sum into unique total). Antagonist 对抗审查 has 1 致命,1 重大,1 次要, duration 15m47s, 57 tool actions, grok-4.6 optional metadata. Main top action no unauthorized operation implied in screenshot; buttons are visual design only.
TYPOGRAPHY/CONTENT: accurate short Chinese labels, prioritize readable key text, use the supplied exact short copy. No English Lorem ipsum, no fake bar charts, no nonexistent functionality shown as fact. Focus primary screen on the stated user goal with one clear primary action and a few supporting links. 
SCREEN NAME: 审查总览 · 结果优先.
Show an elegant completed review page, all within one screenshot.
Main top header y40: breadcrumb and title; right "打开 PR ↗", secondary "导出报告".
Result hero is a typography-led block at y145-280, not a giant card: small "本轮审查已完成 · 5/5 席位已交付" with green check execution, then large warm headline "需要修改" with red small status accent. Below exact short summary "发现 7 项问题，其中 3 项需要优先处理。" Brass primary button "查看阻塞问题"; next secondary "开始修复". Thin divider. Small note "审查结论基于 SHA 6424bc1" and duration 22m09s.
At y316 a simple horizontal section tab row: "发现 7" selected, "汇总报告", "席位结果 5". This is local page navigation, not giant cards. Content split main ~750px and narrow right ~280px.
Main content section title "优先处理" and small "按严重度排序". Three clear stacked editorial finding rows separated by dividers (no separate giant cards): red tag 致命 and headline "重放可能重复拼接已完成正文"; next muted path sessionEventTimeline.ts:269; one line explanation "重连后历史片段再次追加，导致正文重复。"; footer small "对抗审查提出 · 独立验证" and trailing chevron. Second red/amber 重大 "自动重连缺少退避" with "index.tsx:921" and source "安全审查、对抗审查". Third 重大 "空文本完成帧可能清空正文" with "sessionEventTimeline.ts:49". Then understated link "查看其余 4 项问题 ↓".
Right rail title "席位结果"; 5 compact rows each role name, green check 已完成 on its own small line, red/amber numeric finding count and secondary 查看结果 arrow. Crucial label above "席位独立发现可能重叠"; below one small Aggregator completed summary "汇总已完成 · 已合并重复发现".
Bottom main below findings at y840 one horizontal quiet section "下一步" with text "先处理致命与重大问题，再按新版本复审。" and minimal text link "查看完整报告".
Make hierarchy clear and editorial, generous line heights, at least 40px main gutters. No multi-screen board. This is finished production UI, not annotated wireframe.

SCREEN NAME: 已完成席位 · 先读结果.
Input reference image 1 is the approved visual language anchor within this design suite. Match its exact sidebar, colors, typography and flat professional UI, but use the following page composition. Show a completed seat reading workspace, desktop 1440x1024, main app as before. Breadcrumb "报告 / piston #413 / 席位结果". Header title "对抗审查", small green check "执行已完成" SEPARATE from red verdict "需要修改". On right "复制报告" and quiet "返回总览". Metadata line "grok-4.6 · 15m47s · 57 次工具调用" and small "演示数据 · 2026/09/20". Under header a horizontal role tab rail 安全审查 / 正确性审查 / 可维护性审查 / 对抗审查(selected) / 兼容性审查. Short text "发现 3 项问题：1 项致命、1 项重大、1 项次要。此处展示该席位的独立结论。" Then three inline small severity counts in restrained text.
Section y365 title "审查发现". First expanded finding: red small 致命 and headline "重放可能重复拼接已完成正文", path "sessionEventTimeline.ts:269". Short paragraph with exact copy "重连再次接收历史片段时，已完成正文仍会追加相同内容。". A very small code example on subtle raised dark strip: '首次：Hello   →   重连后：HelloHello'. A subsection "建议" with single sentence "对已完成消息去重，并补充混合历史重放测试。".
Following two compact finding rows divided by thin lines, with 重大 "自动重连缺少退避" and 次要 "性能测试未覆盖重连回放"; both expandable chevrons.
Next y710 section title "完整席位报告" with 2-3 short readable paragraphs as visible top portion: "审查范围覆盖事件重放、断线恢复与消息合并。" "核心风险集中在重连后重复追加，以及异常情况下持续全量拉取。"
At bottom y900 a prominent but quiet FULL-WIDTH COLLAPSED DISCLOSURE ROW "历史过程" and secondary "57 次工具调用 · 15m33s 过程记录", trailing "展开过程 ↓". This is BELOW result and report. No log stream above report.
Right outline title "本席位" with anchor list 结论摘要(selected), 审查发现 3, 完整报告, 历史过程; below divider compact small text "执行完成不代表审查通过"; link "查看汇总如何处理这些发现 ↗" as later capability preview subordinate. Do not show live-running dot. Rich readable long-form typography, comfortable length and whitespace.

Below thin divider a single Aggregator row gray "等待席位交付", note "独立结果可先查看". Do not wrap each row in a card.

All based on visible event, no speculation.
Below y445 heading "实时过程" and one secondary control "仅看关键进展" toggle. Chronological grouped activity:
10:42 brass dot, text "已核对消息合并逻辑，开始验证重连后的重放行为。"
10:43 chevron small file icon "读取 3 个文件" with short muted paths "sessionEventTimeline.ts · sessionEventStream.ts …" collapsed.
11:26 blue command icon "运行重放回归测试" with code command shown on a compact mono strip, status "执行中" (not success).
11:50 a collapsed line "思考内容 · 已折叠" muted.
End center area with plenty of empty space, faint spinner/blue small dot and copy "等待新的过程输出…".
At bottom of right panel y920 fixed small bar "正在跟随最新活动" with blue dot and button "暂停跟随". Beneath or just above compact advisory "已完成席位的结果可立即查看，汇总结论尚未生成。" No error alerts, no invented ETA, no huge loading skeleton, no red failure status.
This screen must make current action obvious in three seconds, seat completion visible, and currently scrolling activity secondary to current action. Avoid duplicative card stacks and do not use the big red verdict from completed screen.

SCREEN NAME: 历史过程 · 可检索的分组记录.
Reference image is the same design suite: preserve its sidebar, type, colors, borders. Single desktop screen 1440x1024 app UI, no annotations.
Show seat detail in process reading mode with header "对抗审查", green "执行已完成", metadata "grok-4.6 · 执行 15m47s · 过程记录 15m33s", date "演示数据 · 2026/09/20", top right button "返回审查结果" (brass).
Below header five horizontal compact role tabs exactly as reference, 对抗审查 selected.
At y250 a quiet RESULT CONTEXT STRIP, not a big card: red label "独立意见：需要修改", text "3 项发现", trailing "查看完整报告 ↑". Thus result never lost while reading logs.
At y305 process header "历史过程", secondary "共 57 次工具调用". Wide input search with placeholder "搜索已保存的过程、路径或命令". Below compact filter tabs 全部(selected) / 进展 / 工具 / 思考. Right "折叠全部". No fake semantic phases, just objective activity groups.
Main timeline x260-1090 with timestamp gutter 64px, thin vertical subtle line; right slim sidebar x1130-1400 title "记录概况", text rows "执行时长 15m47s" "记录跨度 15m33s" "工具调用 57"; divider; small copy "过程记录用于追溯，审查结论见席位报告。".
Timeline content:
00:07 brass dot, Agent progress sentence "先读取审查上下文与变更，再核对重连路径。"
00:08 small collapsed chevron file icon group "读取 6 个文件" and muted "review-context.diff · sessionEventTimeline.ts · 其他 4 个".
02:07 expanded search group "搜索 3 次" with 3 compact child rows, each monospace actual query "lastDurableSeq", "prepareReconnect", "appendEvent", and subtle labels 搜索记录. No generic unreadable paragraphs.
04:22 progress statement "发现重放可能重复追加，继续构造最小验证用例。".
05:30 command group "执行 2 条命令" expanded, raised code block "pnpm test -- sessionEventTimeline" and label "调用结束" NOT 测试通过, second code "node scripts/replay-probe.mjs" and label "调用结束". Tiny note "这里只记录调用状态，不代表验证通过。" No fabricated tool output except given command strings.
09:12 collapsed reasoning group "思考内容 · 已折叠".
15:33 green small document icon "席位报告已生成" and small link "查看结果".
Keep rows compact but readable, document style, no separate big card per event, no artificial play/replay transport, no ongoing live follow bar because terminal state. Overall polished developer tool readability.
